name: print-social-digital-marketing-agency-post-with-orange-to-crimson-fade
title: 'Digital Marketing Agency' post with a portrait fading into an orange-to-crimson gradient
whatItIs: A square post with a faded laptop scene behind a smiling woman in a patterned headwrap, the lower half washed by an orange-to-crimson gradient carrying a white headline, a bracketed yellow-bordered tagline, phone numbers and a yellow 'Join us' pill.
whatItMeans: Warm and vibrant; the fade blends person and message into one glow.
techniques: Fade a warm gradient up from the bottom to hold text.
Frame the tagline in a thin outlined box.
Ghost a background scene for context.

vocabulary.definition: A gradient rising from the base to create a text area.
